statement: The orientation of the 1532 Honterus Chorographia resists verification and is marked uncertain rather than asserted.
resolution_path: Consult the surviving impression once located.

statement: The single known print is recorded as 'likely Budapest'; the holding institution is not confirmed.
resolution_path: Confirm the repository and shelfmark before any survival_unknown attestation is resolved.

statement: Drobeta cannot securely be matched to an entry in Ptolemy's catalogue of forty-four poleis.
resolution_path: Record as source_silent at low confidence unless an edition settles the identification.

statement: The exact site of Vicina is unsettled in the literature.
resolution_path: Carry as scholarly_reconstruction with competing candidates rather than one point.

statement: The KAN-349 timeline is normalized but no witness scope or absence state has been reviewed by a named researcher.
resolution_path: Select bounded samples, review source scope and locators, then promote individual states; do not bulk-promote the timeline.

statement: The KAN-354 source and claim ledgers are candidate research records, not reviewed interpretations of territorial advocacy.
resolution_path: Review each high-importance claim against the cited map, legend, text, or diplomatic record and name the reviewer.

statement: No high-resolution Borroczyn or later comparison witness currently combines adequate parcel detail with a production-wide reuse grant.
resolution_path: Obtain a production-resolution reproduction and written reuse terms from the holding institution, or document a rights-cleared equivalent witness.

statement: No line in the Roman Dacia baseline is digitised from a survey or an open licensed dataset. Roads are straight joins between attested stations and the three frontier corridors are drawn by this project at provincial scale.
resolution_path: Replace the drawn corridors with digitised geometry from a licensed source, or cite a reusable dataset, and raise the provenance class from editorial_reconstruction accordingly. Until then this blocks Terra Sigillata's data gate: the roman-dacia baseline is the trench's Roman-era spatial evidence, and an editorial_reconstruction corridor is not yet a passable answer to that gate's question.

statement: The principality rings are schematic envelopes, not delimitations. Two known simplifications are recorded: the Budjak and Cetatea Alba are not separated from Moldavia before 1775, and the southern Bessarabian districts returned in 1856 are not drawn as their own phase.
resolution_path: Cut the two missing phases and reconcile the rings against a delimitation source before any layer here is cited as a boundary. Until then this blocks Dacia Rediviva's data gate: Trench F argues over how antiquity has been used in territorial claims, and the principality envelopes are its spatial register for that argument.

statement: Every sheet in the Josephinian index carries archive_sheet_id 'pending': the footprints are a reconstructed graticule and no row has been matched to the Kriegsarchiv's own sheet number.
resolution_path: Match each footprint to its Kriegsarchiv sheet number and replace the reconstructed graticule with the archive's index geometry.

statement: Seven of ten name-use rows carry Vlad Simion's recorded human review, covering every fate class the released essay displays: applicatio, translatio and restitutio. Three additional source-located rows remain normalized and are explicitly withheld; the essay does not promote their claims.
resolution_path: Keep normalized rows below the public compiler threshold until a named reviewer checks the cited locator. Adding inventio to the public argument requires promotion of its decree-preamble row first.

statement: Every name-use row now resolves to a source and locator. The 1228 Dominican use cites the general-chapter constitutions; the 1974 reception and Napoca restoration uses cite the decree preamble and Articol unic separately.
resolution_path: Preserve the exact locators and the distinction between source-located normalization and human review.

statement: The official-gazette scan of Decret nr. 194/1974 is source-checked, sufficient and cleared as PD-RO-exempt/no known restrictions. It is the sole historical reproduction in the essay; all other candidates remain research-only.
resolution_path: Keep the five uncleared candidates out of production unless their object identity, resolution and reuse basis are separately resolved.

statement: No line in the treaty-frontier layer is digitised from a delimitation source. The KAN-351 ledger records why for each instrument: no_geometry for Adrianople and the 1944 armistice, commission_geometry_required for Paris 1856 and Bucharest 1913, map_not_georeferenced for Berlin, Trianon and Paris 1947, and annex_map_unacquired for the Second Vienna Award.
resolution_path: Acquire and georeference the Berlin, Trianon and 1947 annex maps, and the Vienna Award annex, then raise those phases above editorial_reconstruction. Carta Rubra argues over this frontier, so its data gate depends on the linework being real.

statement: No sheet has been physically inspected. in-manibus-inspections.csv holds headers only, and an objects.csv row may be created only from an inspection whose status is reviewed, so the held-object corpus is empty at its first link rather than its last.
resolution_path: A named inspector examines each candidate sheet and records recto, verso, folds, colour, repairs, dimensions and provenance clues against the inspection schema. A scan or an existing catalogue description cannot be promoted in its place.

statement: No reproduction of a held Dacia sheet has a settled rights basis, and the three candidates in the enrichment queue - specht, peutinger, honterus - carry neither an image source nor a rights statement.
resolution_path: Photograph the inspected sheets and record the project's own rights basis for those images, or settle terms for an institutional surrogate where the sheet is not held.

statement: In Manibus is an object-centred essay whose every claim is meant to resolve to an inspected object, and it must distinguish direct observation from inference. With no inspections and no object evidence, there is nothing for the prose to resolve to and the distinction it exists to draw has no material on either side.
resolution_path: Close vd-in-manibus-inspection first: the essay is downstream of the inspections and of the object-evidence rows they permit, and cannot be written ahead of them.
